'''Eva Christensen''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Christensen first began to provide voices in Pokémon during [[S07|the seventh season]]. As with most other voice actors who worked with [[4Kids Entertainment]], she left when {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. Later, she provided the voice of {{OBP|Mitchell|DP148}} in ''[[DP148|Try for the Family Stone!]]'', making her the second-to-last former 4Kids voice actor to return to the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|DP}}. Christensen is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.
